workload: SIFT100M A→B, 40K queries, each phase 10K uniform + 10K Zipf0.8 shuffled
modes: private one LRU per worker, clear before each query
cache_clear: sync + POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED per file; mincore verification
timing: Overall QPS includes per-query reset; summed reset CPU time across workers is not wall time.
validation: Every result ID equals existing 40K×10 reference. Private-reset per-query visit/hit/read counts must exactly equal the single-thread 103-page reset run.
scope: Experiment-only snapshot; shared version and private version use identical executable and total payload budget. Private version shares immutable D and seed map only. It changes ownership, LRU partitioning, locking and query-boundary retention, so it cannot separately attribute performance to any single factor.
